- Confirm final signer authority for both docs (MSA + Order Form).
- Confirm whether Brightwell requires witness or notary on either document.
- Confirm preferred DocuSign routing order and whether you'd like separate envelopes or a single envelope with recipient roles.

Attachments: MSA_Brightwell_redline_v4.pdf, OrderForm_Brightwell_0603.docx, signature_mapping.xlsx

1) Procurement (review & countersign)
2) Brightwell CFO (exec signature)
3) Redwood VP Legal (final sign/ack)
4) Redwood Ops (post-sign clean-copy handoff + archive)

Karthik — tagging you for any legal flags on the redline and to confirm our final signatory block. Rafael — can you prepare a final clean PDF and a DocuSign draft once we have signers? ETA needed (hour estimate). Ellie, if you can confirm procurement contact and who will actually sign, we can schedule envelope for next-day signing.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa — thanks for sending. Quick answers from our side:

- Signer authority: Brightwell will have the CFO (Mark Jin) sign the MSA and the Head of Ops (I will sign the Order Form for procurement clearance and then Mark will countersign).
- Procurement contact: procurement@brightwelltx.com (CC'd) — they handle PO issuance after countersign.
- Witness/notary: We do NOT require notarization for this engagement. We do require a witness line on the Order Form (internal policy).

We prefer a single envelope that contains both the MSA (signature: Mark) and Order Form (signature: Ellie, then Mark). Routing should be: 1) Ellie (Order Form) -> 2) Mark (MSA + countersign Order Form) -> 3) Redwood Legal (acknowledge)

If Redwood needs any additional signatory verification (PDF of signer IDs or corporate resolution) let me know and I can loop procurement.

Best,
Ellie Harper
VP, Operations | Brightwell Therapeutics

Subject: RE: Clean-copy handoff & DocuSign plan for Brightwell MSA + Order Form

Thanks Vanessa / Ellie — reviewed the MSA redline (attached notes). Two quick legal items to resolve before we send envelope: 

1) Section 7.2 (Indemnity carve-outs) — Brightwell requested adding a limitation for third-party claims arising solely from Brightwell data. Acceptable, but we need a short confirmatory clause (I inserted language in the redline).
2) Data retention schedule — match Order Form term (36 months) explicitly in Section 9.

If Brightwell confirms both items we are clear for signature. On DocuSign routing: Redwood legal prefers to be listed as a CC recipient (receives final PDF) rather than an active signer so we get the timestamped evidence in our archive without holding the envelope. Rafael — when you create the draft envelope please:
- Use recipient routing order: Ellie (Order Form signer), Mark (MSA signer & order form countersign), procurement@brightwelltx.com (receives final executed copy)
- Set recipient authentication to email only; no KBA unless Brightwell requests it.
- Add a Signing Complete webhook to our S3 archive bucket (I will provide the webhook address privately).

Attachment: MSA_Brightwell_redline_v4_KI_comments.pdf (redline with inline legal notes).

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Thanks — Rafael, please take the following action items: 

- Produce the final clean PDFs (post-Karthik redline) and flatten to a single PDF bundle. Deliver ETA and estimate of time needed (hours).
- Draft a single DocuSign envelope with the routing below and save as a draft. Link below once ready: https://app.docusign.net/envelope/draft/placeholder

Final routing to implement in DocuSign (per Ellie & Karthik):
1) Ellie Harper — Signer (Order Form)
2) Mark Jin — Signer (MSA) and Countersign (Order Form)
3) procurement@brightwelltx.com — Receives final executed copy (CC)
4) Redwood Legal (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — CC (final PDF)

Set envelope settings: email authentication only, require initialing on each signature block for Order Form witness line, allow comments disabled, require copy to procurement. Rafael, please confirm whether DocuSign's "witness" field is sufficient or if we should add a separate signature field for a witness line (Ellie asked for witness). If witness needs to be a third person, add a field for: Witness Name / Witness Signature under Order Form.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543 (please attach executed PDF to the deal record).

Once draft is ready I will run a 10-minute internal dry run (Karthik + Rafael + Neha) then we route externally. ETA for external send: tomorrow by 11a PT if PDF cleanup completes today.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
